mission.title: Smoke Signals
mission.description: Investigate the strange code signature and the dead redpills it leaves behind.

phase.briefing:
Something urgent has come to our attention, and it is necessary that you investigate. The strange code signature noted by your operator has been reported again.
Proceed to the location indicated, and survey the situation.

enter.say: This is the spot, and I'm picking up that signal again. I don't know what it is, but it just rubs me the wrong way somehow. Let's make this quick.

done.say: More dead bodies! I'm scanning the RSIs... if you see any useful evidence, grab it before you get out of there.

phase.briefing: I find it highly probable that these dead persons belonged to Zion's organization. Proceed to one of Zion's outposts to request information. The contact there is named Adzhimushkaj.

enter.say: Hopefully the RSI scans I took should be useful.

talk.say:
Hey, you must be {player}, right? Glad to see you; we can definitely use some help.
We've already checked out the RSI data your operator collected. Talk to Zion Selective Phage; she's been analyzing the report.

Okay, here's the short version of the report.
Those two bodies you found? We have a positive ID on one of them. The name's Dobrovolsky; from what I've heard, nobody you'd really want covering your back. Not the most trustworthy sort, you know?
The other body is still an unknown. What they were doing in the same place, or why they ended up dead... who knows?
I'm sending a little packet along to your operator. Somebody who knew Dobrovolsky; maybe they can help you out.

phase.briefing: Proceed to the site indicated, and interview Gajdariya. His knowledge of the dead operative may provide some insight into these events.

talk.say:
I heard you'd be coming. I also heard about Dobrovolsky. What a shame... but I guess that's what you get from hanging around that kind of crowd.
You didn't know? Dobrovolsky and Anome were big pals. Yup. I think they had some sort of falling out a little while back, but Dobrovolsky never talked much about it.
I don't know what else I can tell ya.

done.say: I can't get my mind around everything that's been happening... Niobe gone, Anome who-knows-where... It's crazy.

mission.finish:
So... a friend of Anome's has a falling out; Anome comes into possession of the vials; the friend dies near our... mysterious code signature. An obvious conclusion can be drawn here.
We shall be in contact soon, {player}.
